title: Pal Dot Dance
style: Alternative R&B and dembow fusion with a bouncy half-time groove, skittering percussion, rubbery sub-bass, and a clipped club rhythm that leans into Russian rap phrasing; verse rides sparse drums and synth stabs, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and vocal chops, chorus lands with stacked high vocal doubles and call-and-response chants. Ad-lib pings, reverse swells, and glittery ear candy between lines; intimate close-mic lead, bright and punchy mix., bounce, latin, rap, alternative r&b

a i code lyrics only
clap and rap song
rappal.app
rap pal dot app

you got that?
sing it back pal
rap back
wanna dance pal

dance latin america pal
go to pal dot dance

[Pre-Chorus]
bounce, bounce, bounce
high vocals in the room
kid computer voces

be my song pal
say it again

rap pal dot app
